items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: Yes, Hilaire was good. Hilaire was good.

ctx.x: Oh, I was wondering about the drummer on those Jelly Roll records, Andrew Hilaire. Hilaire, Andrew Hilaire. I never got to meet him. I guess he died a couple years ago.

Yes, he died. And he was a very good drummer. And he's a good musician too. He could read. He could read. He could read. And he had that, uh, had a good rhythm too. Yeah, sounds fine on him. Yes, Hilaire was good. Hilaire was good. But, uh, I don't think he, uh, got around. But no, I don't think he, he played around Chicago yet, but I don't think. But he was from Louisiana too. Oh, I didn't know where he came from. Yeah, he's from Louisiana. That's right.

I don't think it's from New Orleans. Now down in New Orleans, in almost every band, the trumpet player, the cornet is the leader, and he'll stomp off and all. Yeah, yeah. I wonder when you made the Jelly records, I guess Jelly, of course, was the leader, but he's stomping off, or how would he do it?
